title: project.verify result
description: Verify every source and object against the bytes on disk, writing nothing. Absent media is not a contradiction: `verified` and `contradicted` are separate because an unbound source is neither.

artifacts.description: Every recorded artifact, checked against the bytes on disk. The three answers carry different weights on purpose: a missing file is not a failure, because an artifact records what was made so it can be remade, and deleting a generated directory must stay safe; a stale recipe key is the expected state after editing a resource, and is what an export surface renders as "needs re-export"; only a digest that disagrees is a contradiction, because the document asserts bytes the file does not have.

present.description: Whether the file is there with the digest the record pins.

current.description: Whether the recipe that made it is still the project's recipe.

detail.description: A sentence for a person. Never parse this; match on `status`.

status.description: What verification found, as a stable code. This is the machine contract; `detail` is prose for a person and may be reworded in any release.

contradicted.description: Separate from `verified` because they are not opposites: an unbound source is neither.

detail.description: A sentence for a person. Never parse this; match on `status`.
